snippet.title: Wildcard | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Official Wildcard Trailer

Welcome to the official trailer of Wildcard, the ultimate PvP strategic action game. Discover the thrill of building decks, summoning powerful companions, and dominating dynamic arenas with your Champions! Wildcard is a first-of-its-kind hybrid of real-time strategy, arena-based MOBAs, and collectible card games, all powered by cutting-edge technology. Witness the pulse-pounding mix of action and strategy in our NEW trailer.

What is Wildcard?
Wildcard is a third-person, 2v2 Collectible Card Action Game (CCAG) that seamlessly blends fast-paced arena combat with strategic deck building. As a champion, you battle in real-time, summoning powerful creatures from your deck to fight alongside you. Master dynamic abilities, outplay opponents with skillful action mechanics, and harness the power of your summons in a thrilling fusion of collectible card strategy and third-person action combat—all set in a live, interactive arena.

WISHLIST / PLAYTESTING :

See you in the Arena!
